problem: Placing the Open Kitchen and Dirty Kitchen side-by-side makes both rooms 6 ft wide by 15.25 ft deep—long, narrow tunnels where a 2 ft counter leaves barely 3.5 ft of passage and no room for two people to pass or open appliances.
fix: Divide the 12 x 15.25 ft kitchen zone front-to-back instead of left-to-right: place a 12 x 6.5 ft Dirty Kitchen at the back against the Rear Space and a 12 x 8.75 ft Open Kitchen in front opening to the TV Lounge & Dining, connected by a 3 ft door.

problem: Bath 2 sits directly over the front-left corner of the Drawing Room, meaning soil and waste pipes will run through the formal guest ceiling and risk visible leaks.
fix: Move Bath 2 to the back of Bedroom 2 against the Stair Hall wall so its plumbing drops down outside the main Drawing Room ceiling.

problem: There is no powder room on the ground floor, so Drawing Room guests must walk through the family TV Lounge and into the Parents' Bedroom to use a bathroom.
fix: Tuck a 4 x 5 ft powder room under the high flight and landing of the Stair Hall, opening discreetly near the Drawing Room door.
